title: SFTTradingExample
description: Schema for one supervised fine-tuning training example representing a trading reasoning trace. Each field documents the intended semantic — see SPEC.md Section 2 and 3 for full rationale.

id.description: Unique identifier for this training example (UUID v4).

version.description: Schema version string (semver). Increment minor when fields are added, major when breaking changes occur.

split.description: Dataset split assignment. Must be assigned by a time-ordered split (see SPEC.md Section 7) — never random split.

source.description: Origin of the raw data. Determines default quality weight and legal risk tier.

market.description: Market category. Examples: 'crypto', 'equities', 'prediction_market'. TBD — see OPEN QUESTION Q1.

instrument.description: Trading instrument identifier. Format TBD pending market choice (Q1). Examples: 'BTC/USDT', 'ETH-PERP', 'AAPL', 'will-X-happen'.

timeframe.description: Primary analysis timeframe. TBD pending definition of 'trading idea' granularity (Q2).

timestamp_context.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp representing the moment the context snapshot was taken — i.e., the information cutoff for this example. All market data in 'context' must be prior to this timestamp.

system_prompt.description: The system/instruction prompt that frames the task for the model. Defines persona, market domain, output format requirements, and any style constraints.

context.description: The user-turn content: a natural language description of the market context at timestamp_context. Should include price action, relevant indicators, any macro/news catalysts, and optionally on-chain data or positioning. This is the model's input at inference time.

reasoning.description: The chain-of-thought reasoning trace: the model's (or human's) step-by-step analysis leading to the decision. This is the primary training signal for teaching reasoning style. Target length: 150–600 tokens.

decision.description: Structured trade decision that concludes the reasoning. All sub-fields TBD pending Q2 (granularity of a trading idea).

direction.description: Directional bias or action. FLAT = exit/no position. WAIT = monitor, no entry yet.

entry_zone.description: Price range for entry [low, high] or a single market-order price [price]. Optional when direction is WAIT or FLAT.

invalidation.description: Price level at which the thesis is invalidated and the position should be closed. Required for LONG/SHORT.

targets.description: One or more price targets in ascending order for LONG, descending for SHORT.

position_size_pct.description: Suggested position size as a percentage of total portfolio / risk capital. TBD — may be normalized differently depending on account type (Q7).

confidence.description: Subjective conviction score. 1 = speculative/low conviction, 5 = high conviction. Used for quality filtering.

outcome.description: Realized outcome metadata. NEVER included in the model's input context — used only for quality filtering and train/test split stratification. See SPEC.md Section 6.

realized_pnl_pct.description: Realized PnL as a percentage of the risked capital (not total portfolio). Positive = profit.

holding_period_hours.description: Duration between entry and exit in hours.

verdict.description: Outcome classification. EXPIRED = thesis did not trigger (no trade taken, invalidation/target never hit within a defined window).

exit_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of trade exit. Optional.

quality_score.description: Composite quality score in [0, 1] computed by the labeling pipeline (see label.py). Combines outcome verdict, LLM-judge coherence score, source tier, and specificity signals.
